notes: ACCESS: tier (a) HTTP fetch (requests) was blocked by a Cloudflare managed challenge (403 'Just a moment...' on robots.txt and pages) - dropped to tier (b). Playwright/Chromium headless (with a real-Chrome UA string) reached every page cleanly with no further blocks, so tier (b) was used for the entire extraction; Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) was not needed and was confirmed disconnected anyway. robots.txt (fetched via Playwright) only disallows /login.php, /account, /checkout and similar account/checkout paths plus many country-code paths; it does not name anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot, so no tier is blocked by policy. TREE: built from the rendered mega-menu (header nav, all 10 top sections) plus each category page's own '.child-categories__list' sibling/child carousel, confirming h1 and canonical on every leaf visited (~55 pages loaded). QTY: read from the 'data-cnstrc-num-results' attribute on the product-list section (cross-checked against the visible 'N products' text node in the same HTML, which matched on every page checked). EXCLUDED and why: Decor>Wall hanging (3 products - inspected: a wall-art panel, a wood room-divider disc, and one throw; predominantly non-textile Wall Decor content, so the node was dropped entirely per textile.md S14, not force-included for the one throw); Bedroom>Nightwear & Dressing gowns (apparel/loungewear category per textile.md S19, and also showed 0 products); Tableware>Napkins (inspected: paper napkins, not cloth - excluded per textile.md S15/S16, distinct from the genuine Tableware>Table linen>Cloth napkins node which was kept); Storage: Lifestyle>Home office>Wastebaskets & Recycling (trash/recycling bins, not organizational storage of belongings - not covered by any storage.md inclusion list, excluded); Lifestyle>Bags & Cases>Bags (fashion/carrying bags, excluded per storage.md S6); String System and HAY Colour Crate (brand/product-line landing pages, not standard category/subcategory listing pages, excluded per the View-All/Collections rule). Rugs (top-level nav item and all 5 of its material subcategories) showed '0 products' consistently across the en-us, en, and en-gb locale variants - recorded as a genuine zero-product category rather than omitted, per the zero-product-category allowance. Storage>Storage furniture and its 4 children (Sideboards & Dressers, Storage units, TV stands, Cabinets) sit on furniture/storage boundary items per storage.md S21 - the site's own breadcrumb and URL path place them under Storage (not under the separate Furniture nav section), so they were included as Storage with MEDIUM confidence and a boundary flag rather than being silently dropped. Coat racks & Hangers subcategories (Wall hooks, Coat stands, Coat hangers, Umbrella stands) are similarly borderline hardware/furniture-adjacent items; included per explicit Storage-section website hierarchy with LOW/MEDIUM confidence as noted per-row. No duplicate rows were created; every recorded leaf has its own distinct listing URL and independently-read quantity (no aggregation).
